programme.title: Minnal Murali
programme.desc: Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.

programme.title: Dashing Khiladi 2
programme.desc: A man loves a woman but also faces threats from goons. However, when the gangster murders his friend and kidnaps the woman he loves, he strives to take revenge.

programme.title: Aakhri Chaal : Ab kaun bachega
programme.desc: Three brothers conspire against each other in a bid to take over their father's criminal empire following his sudden death. Meanwhile, someone else tries to take advantage of the rift between them.

programme.title: Ezra
programme.desc: After Priya buys an antique box, she and Ranjan experience eerie events. Later, they seek a rabbi's help to uncover its dark history and confront the malevolent force within.

programme.title: Coolie Raja
programme.desc: When a woman from a wealthy family falls in love with a porter, the couple tries to prove that their love is stronger than the differences in their social status.

programme.title: Pichaikkaran
programme.desc: A rich businessman and a poor beggar's lives intersect, showing how money influences their fates as one fights off greedy predators and the other searches for his long-lost sister.

programme.title: Bholaa Shankar
programme.desc: A cab driver in Calcutta struggles to rebuild his life with his sister while confronting a haunting past. Subsequently, he fights to protect his future and family from the city's gritty underworld.

programme.title: Devara: Part 1
programme.desc: A fierce sea warrior violently opposes his village's criminal activities, while years later, his gentle son charts his own course, creating a stark contrast in paths.

programme.title: Maragadha Naanayam
programme.desc: Senguttuvan and Elango work for a smuggler who hires them to retrieve an emerald medallion, a cursed treasure linked to many deaths. Seeking help, they consult a priest and summon three spirits to locate it.

programme.title: Gatta Kusthi
programme.desc: Veera has a preconceived set of criteria for what he wants in a bride. However, he ends up unexpectedly marrying a woman who is the complete opposite of his expectations.

programme.title: Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior
programme.desc: Tanhaji, a Maratha warrior, is Shivaji Maharaj's trusted lieutenant. When the Mughals invade and conquer Kondhana fort, he sets out to reclaim it for his king and country.
